data.name: Portal.Customer.Help
data.value: Send this link to your customer: they find their invoices and quotes, pay online and sign quotes, without creating an account.

data.name: Portal.Invoice.Help
data.value: Send this link to your customer: they pay by card in seconds and the payment is recorded automatically against the invoice.

data.name: Portal.Quote.Help
data.value: Your customer signs the quote online: it is accepted at once and, if you ask for it, the down payment invoice is created and validated right after.

data.name: Portal.Copied
data.value: Link copied: paste it into your message to the customer.

data.name: Portal.CopyFailed
data.value: Could not copy: select the address in the field.

data.name: Portal.ValidUntil
data.value: Valid until {0}. Lettra does not keep the full address: copy it now.

data.name: Portal.Revoked
data.value: Link revoked: it no longer opens.

data.name: Portal.Disabled
data.value: The customer area needs the firm's server, with a service account declared for it. It is not open on this installation.

data.name: Portal.Signature.Simulated
data.value: Demonstration: simple electronic signature by a simulated provider (name, consent, timestamp, fingerprint).

data.name: Error.Portal.Disabled
data.value: The customer area is not open on this installation (it needs the firm's server).

data.name: Error.Portal.LinkNotFound
data.value: This link does not exist, has expired or has been revoked.

data.name: Error.Portal.ValidityInvalid
data.value: A link lasts from 1 to 90 days.

data.name: Error.Portal.DownPaymentInvalid
data.value: The down payment goes from 0.01 to 100 %, and only on a quote link.

data.name: Error.Portal.QuoteNotSignable
data.value: This quote cannot be signed online: it must be validated, still valid, and addressed to this customer.

data.name: Error.Portal.SignerNameInvalid
data.value: The signer's name goes from 2 to 120 characters.

data.name: Error.Portal.ConsentRequired
data.value: The signer must give their consent.

data.name: Error.Portal.CheckoutNotFound
data.value: This online payment is unknown or has expired.

data.name: Error.Portal.SignatureNotFound
data.value: This quote was not signed online.
